description: Native HumMod higher-work bicycle exercise probe. Engineering fidelity test only.

provenance.purpose: Determine the native HumMod high-work tachycardic/autonomic response without imposing a browser HR target.
limitations: Engineering stress probe, not a patient exercise prescription.
HumMod's maximum-exercise reference discusses approximately 256 W for its reference sedentary middle-aged male; this probe remains below that reference estimate.
